groups.reason: Colorado occurs in a recollection of where the group played the island adventure and plausibly names the real-world venue. It does not justify substituting an in-world place.
Delwath describes the tradition of the spirits from whom he receives magic; the cultural reference establishes the spelling.
Riswynn's worship, protective and healing magic, and the seven points of the crown all identify the dwarven gods; their reference supplies the established spelling.
The group discusses tracking Rai as a future quest; the distinctive spoken form matches the established Isingue name and pronunciation. This corrects the place name without asserting a later outcome.
Kenzo is activating the named claw power. The earlier session records Lengau's Claw for Kenzo, and Lengau's reference confirms the name despite the Lengua spelling in the current session note.
The party asks whether their communication stone works so they can contact Sura; the item reference establishes message stone.
The marked religious term is immediately glossed as anti-divine; the pantheon reference establishes the Mos Numena name. The existing anti prefix is retained.

evidence.path: Gods and Religions/Gods/Incorporeal Gods/Mos Numena Pantheon/Mos Numena Pantheon.md

groups.reason: Riswynn discusses religious advisers in a council. Mystai is the documented title that strongly fits the sound and religious context, though generic mystics is a possible less specific reading.
Ordinary conversation, mechanics, numbers, or damaged surrounding wording outside the name pass; no name-only replacement is justified.

retainedSpans.u0076:m1: {{Rest that brings some sort of restoration}}

groups.reason: The mural depicts the mass executions of the elven people persecuted by Apollyon; the reference explicitly records these public massacres.

Wellby is plausible given his attack in the preceding encounter, but the complete marked phrase may contain additional wording or a spoken name mistake; its boundaries do not support a name-only replacement.
Wellby identifies the arrows that give his attack its missing bonus; the purchase record explicitly lists Skaer arrows, and the current session account names their use.
Each occurrence refers to the party skyship, during the Drankor overflight, contact, or return to its deck; the ship reference establishes its name.
The contacted Dunmari ally provides military and peace-negotiation news. The matching session timeline and aftermath identify her as Sura; the already correct occurrence is unmarked.
These spirits support Delwath's attacks and killing blow; the reference identifies the small gods and the session account independently names them in this battle.
The collective spirits interposing themselves for Delwath match the tanshi already manifesting for his defensive and offensive abilities in this battle; Crunchy is a less direct recognition.
Thark and freeing orcs fit the discussion, but the complete marked span also contains damaged ordinary wording. Resolving the name would require reconstructing the phrase.
All three occurrences concern the same Dunmari city and its safety from Chelite assassins; the road reference establishes Tokra as the place name.
